To find out which developed countries have much lower BMI than the UK based on standard health studies and datasets (often referenced in comparative health literature regarding Body Mass Index), we look at global health rankings. France and Japan are widely recognized for having significantly lower average BMIs compared to English-speaking Western nations like the UK, the US, Canada, and Australia. 

Looking at the given options:
(A) The United States has much lower BMI than the UK (False, US generally has a higher BMI)
(B) There are much lower BMIs in Canada and New Zealand (False, comparable or higher)
(C) Australia (Comparable)
(D) There are lower BMIs in America (False)
(E) Canada (Comparable)
(F) The United States (False)
(G) France and Japan have lower BMI than the UK (True)

Final answer: G
